_about: Generation Zero's Steam achievements. The list (name, description, icon, which ones are secret = hidden on Steam until unlocked) is the generation-zero.fandom.com 'Achievements' page (MediaWiki parse API, revision 11984, read 2026-11-06; text CC BY-SA), in its order. The count matches the Steam store (store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=704270: achievements.total = 72), and the ten achievements the store highlights match by name (steam_icon = their Steam icon file). The game files don't hold the achievement list, and Steam's global unlock percentages (api.steampowered.com, steamcommunity.com) could not be fetched, so there are none. The icons are the 14 shared category icons, copied from the Fandom wiki into docs/img/achievements/.
